messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] Arcadia Health - Dedicated cluster arcadia-prod-1.
Version pin: rwinf-2.3.1 -> rwinf-2.4.0.
Change window: 2026-03-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary slice: slice-3 (2 nodes).
Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/arcadia-dedicated-rollout
Rollback criteria (configured):
```
error_rate: >2.0% for 5m
p95_latency_ms: >800 for 5m
```
Please confirm blackout constraints from CS and infra readiness. (deploy-bot)

sara: Confirmed with CS/legal. Arcadia has a maintenance blackout 02:30-03:00 UTC — they asked we avoid heavy traffic shifts in that 30m window. Recommend we do initial ramp before blackout and then pause.

chad: Runtime note: deploying rwinf-runtime:gpu-2.4 (kernel bump + kv-cache warm-up behavior change). Canary config: batch_size=8, max_concurrency=16. I'll watch GPU mem and kernel logs.

mira: SRE checklist pre-canary done: synthetic p95 probes, output validation harness queued, per-tenant cost probe enabled. I'll post quick checks during ramp.

juan: Arcadia Ops flagged small batch jobs at 02:45 UTC — they'd prefer minimal disruption then. If we hit rollback, CS wants notification within 5m.

deploy-bot: canary started @2398765460. slice-3 nodes allocated: 10.3.2.45, 10.3.2.46. Traffic ramp plan: 0% -> 10% over 5m, then to 50% if stable.

mira: synthetic probe baseline p95=230ms. Canary p95=260ms after warm-up. No errors reported yet.

chad: seeing expected KV cache warm-up on node-46; GPU util rising but within margin.

deploy-bot: canary traffic progressed: 10% -> 50% at 2398765520 per schedule.

mira: alert: model-inference-errors increased 0.1% -> 1.8% in last 2m for tenant arcadia-evt. Not yet at 2% threshold but pattern looks like auth failures (401).

chad: digging logs: 401 spikes correlate with upstream header rewrite missing for arcadia-tenant on node-46 — seems envoy config didn't pick up new mapping. Preparing config patch.

sara: Hold traffic ramp. @deploy-bot pause.

deploy-bot: actioned: traffic ramp paused at 50%.

chad: pushed envoy header-fix to node-46 and node-45, restarted proxy (graceful). PTAL.

mira: errors dropping back to 0.3% after proxy restart, p95 back to ~240ms. Suggest resuming ramp but slower increments.

sara: Arcadia CS OK with resuming if we limit to +10% every 10m (they want to avoid hitting their batch job at 02:45). Proceed with cautious ramp.

deploy-bot: resuming ramp with constraint: +10% every 10m starting from 50%.

alex: small product request — update release notes with: "fix: header routing for tenant arcadia to prevent 401 spikes; runtime kernel upgrade; fallback path enabled." Also note the pause and mitigation in changelog.

juan: I'll message Arcadia ops channel with summary and ETA for full cutover once we pass 90%.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 2398765800. All nodes upgraded to rwinf-2.4.0. Post-deploy checks: synthetic p95 within baseline, errors <0.2%, KV cache healthy.
Closing thread. :party-parrot:
